preconditions.description: The number of pastures n must be between 2 and 100,000.
The number of paths m must be between 1 and 300,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and ai != bi and 1 <= li <= 10**9 for ai, bi, li in paths)
preconditions.description: Each path must connect distinct pastures within the valid range and have a positive length.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not can_pave else min_longest_path
postconditions.description: If a sunny paving is not possible, output -1; otherwise, output the minimum possible length of the longest path.
